# Enrai — Free OpenAI-Compatible AI API

> Enrai is a free AI API for developers: one API key for several models (Chatgpt, Deepseek, GLM),
> exposed through an OpenAI-compatible REST API (`POST /v1/chat/completions`, `GET /v1/models`)
> with SSE streaming and automatic provider failover. Base URL: https://enrai.web.id/v1

Status: public beta, free tier with no credit card.
Rate limits per API key: 20 requests/minute for chat completions (burst 5), 60 requests/minute for
the model list.
Error codes: 401 (invalid key), 429 (rate limit), 500 (server error), 502 (every provider behind
the combo failed).

Languages: English (primary, this file), Indonesian (secondary, https://github.com/enraidev/enrai-free-ai-api/blob/main/README.id.md).

## Bahasa Indonesia

Enrai adalah API AI gratis untuk developer: satu API key untuk beberapa model (Chatgpt, Deepseek,
GLM) lewat REST API kompatibel OpenAI dengan streaming SSE dan failover provider otomatis. Base URL:
https://enrai.web.id/v1 · Status: public beta, tier gratis tanpa kartu kredit · Rate limit per API
key: 20 request/menit untuk chat completion (burst 5), 60 request/menit untuk daftar model.
Dokumentasi bahasa Indonesia: https://github.com/enraidev/enrai-free-ai-api/blob/main/README.id.md
